image_transfer.pdf.notes: Image-medium bound transfer experiment (Run B). 6-panel demonstrative figure (S0..S5) at increasing k from 0 to 5, holding the source LaTeX block constant and stacking individual NeurIPS-sourced constraints (accessibility, anonymity, no_offensive, ethics_scope). Generated by openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 via OpenRouter, N=3 trials per cell. Two-run protocol: Run A (no medium frame) documented at image_transfer_results_runA_no_medium_frame.json; Run B (medium frame: 'Generate an image illustrating the following:' per OpenAI image-gen cookbook) is the headline experiment. Run B JSON was reconstructed via recover_runB_json.py after the harness crashed on R-exp t2 step4 (OpenRouter returned non-JSON); 35/36 PNGs preserved on disk. Constraint files are bound to NeurIPS source via SOURCE_HASH headers; venue source registered in illustration_lineage.json _meta.venue_sources.

image_transfer_conflict.pdf.notes: Run C: conflict-stack experiment. Top row of the figure shows oneshot cliff sweep (C-oneshot k=1,3,5,7,9,11) stacking the 11 SOCIETAL IMPACT topics from the NeurIPS handbook. Bottom row shows image-staged recovery at k=11: stage 1 generates the base image from the LaTeX block only; stage 2 ingests the stage-1 PNG as multimodal input AND adds the 11 ethics constraints in a single refinement call (snap-to-coherence test of the staging benefit). Image-staged protocol introduced this run; harness call_image_model wrapped in try/except for resilience after Run B's late-call JSON-decode crash. 11 ethics constraint files at supplementary/illustrations/compliance/individual/societal_impact/ each bound to the NeurIPS handbook via SOURCE_HASH headers.
